explanation: At GO it is always about 10, and at D2 it is about 0 (1 if a1 led to S1 commonly). At D1 it is higher after an unrewarded trial and when the agent has recently been choosing a2: about 1-2 after a reward in an a1 streak, 3-6 after a non-reward with a1, 3-7 after a reward with a2, and 7-10 after a non-reward with a2, especially after several losses in a row.
